description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and an unspecified variable on the x-axis, comparing four different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 128 to 1024, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of powers of 2 (128, 256, 512, 1024). The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different model or configuration: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line), LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.22 and increases to around 0.37 at x=512, then remains steady at 0.37. The orange line begins at about 0.16, rises to 0.42 at x=512, and then levels off at 0.42. The green line starts at roughly 0.05, increases to 0.39 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.39. The red line starts at approximately 0.24, increases to 0.44 at x=512, and then continues to rise to around 0.52.
